reference.audio_acquisition: none; do not download/copy the album or infer exact settings/algorithm

candidates.consonants: native; not the unselected shared dry-copy policy
candidates.known_limitations: Synthetic scale/native/mix upper/lower delivery passes at both rates; sparse pitch misses remain. No actual-vocal or global repeatability/formant acceptance.

candidates.consonants: native; not the unselected shared dry-copy policy
candidates.known_limitations: Same delivery subset passes; callback allocations, reset and quality failures remain. Fresh graph per render; no priming workaround or product go.

initial_trial.source: one explicitly selected existing permitted 12-second development excerpt; propose a, with exact identity/hash only in ignored private proposal
initial_trial.sample_rate: native registered rate (existing excerpt is 48000); no resampling for this first listen
initial_trial.target_key_scale: user selection required; no key detection or claim that an unconfirmed test key matches the song
initial_trial.voicing: approved PR03 third/fifth/octave above, same for both candidates; preserves continuous source deviation
initial_trial.source_gain: one attenuation-only source-derived scalar min(1, 10^(-24/20)/source_rms), identical for both candidates, dry and all stems; never fit candidate outputs
initial_trial.lead_route: software aligned; exact declared delay, unchanged scaled source PCM

private_route.purpose: development listening preference only, no reference-based pitch/quality grades
requires: explicit user trial/protocol approval bound to scope/protocol/private proposal hashes
exact approved development source/consent/audio hash and key/scale
current compiled identity and full build/source/dependency provenance
finite, duration, lead-null, fixed-timeline and headroom checks before playable export
private_route.annotation_exception: PROPOSED for this listening-only route; requires explicit approval before implementation/use. Existing formal preflight remains unchanged and still requires two completed agreeing human references.
private_route.no_annotations_means: human pitch accuracy and formal vocal quality remain pending; no oracle fabricated from the tracker
private_route.holdout: not permitted; no discovery or holdout opening
private_route.source_qa: dry status provisional; do not denoise, retune, remove bends or repair the source

safe_export.raw: retain failures privately, never overwrite an existing evidence run
safe_export.normalization: no per-candidate/voice output normalization, gain fitting, limiting, clipping, EQ or masking effects
safe_export.files: same-gain dry comparison, aligned lead, three harmony stems, complete sum and settings/evidence index; no album audio
safe_export.failure: nonfinite, missing/late primary output, wrong duration, bad lead null, unsafe peak or metadata/provenance mismatch withholds that candidate's playable export; retain exact failure, no automatic repair
safe_export.playback: never automatic; user opens local previews at low volume after checks; export checks cannot guarantee headphone safety

questions: Which candidate's processed character is more useful, or neither?
Where do articulation, rhythm/bends or note stability sound wrong?
Would this texture be useful in a recorded-vocal production?
feedback.record: private preference plus timestamps; user is not represented as an independent listener or pitch annotator
feedback.grading: no automatic similarity/naturalness score and no PR06B/product acceptance

before_progressing: include development challenge c under explicit approval, without flattening or exclusion
synthetic E2/C6 and inclusive +/-12 boundary/dynamic controls at both rates
retain all known technical failures; obtain credible resolution before PR06B
no new configuration sweep if neither candidate is useful
implementation_status: proposal/preparation only; no approved listening-only renderer or source exception implemented by this document
